sections.title: Comprehensive Table of Contents
sections.notes: TOC covers Modules 1–5. Cross-reference index included.

sections.title: Application Form
sections.notes: FDA Form 356h signed by qualified person. NDA submission.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.notes: Proposed package insert submitted. Warnings and Precautions section contains placeholder text '[TO BE UPDATED AFTER FINAL SAFETY REVIEW]'. Adverse Reactions table references clinical data from study SYN-301 which is listed as ongoing in Section 5.3.5. Requires reconciliation before final submission.

sections.title: Information about the Experts
sections.notes: Declarations from three qualified experts covering quality, nonclinical, and clinical modules.

sections.title: Specific Requirements for Different Types of Applications
sections.notes: Paragraph IV certification submitted. No exclusivity claims.

sections.title: Environmental Risk Assessment
sections.notes: Categorical exclusion claimed under 21 CFR 25.31(a). Small-molecule oral tablet. No significant environmental impact anticipated.

sections.title: Clinical Microbiology
sections.notes: Not applicable. Synvastatin hydrochloride is a lipid-lowering agent; no antimicrobial indication or activity.

sections.title: Pharmacovigilance
sections.notes: MISSING — No Risk Management Plan (RMP), no REMS proposal, and no pharmacovigilance plan submitted. The drug has a known hepatotoxicity signal detected in FAERS analysis (PRR 4.2, p < 0.001). A pharmacovigilance plan addressing this signal is required before NDA approval. This is a critical gap.

sections.title: Case Report Forms and Individual Patient Listings
sections.notes: Individual patient listings for Studies SYN-101, SYN-201, SYN-301 provided in eCTD format.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.notes: Brief introduction to the clinical development program. Covers Phase 1–3 studies.

sections.title: Quality Overall Summary
sections.notes: Complete QOS for drug substance and drug product. Validated analytical methods included.

sections.title: Nonclinical Overview
sections.notes: MISSING — Nonclinical overview not submitted. Pharmacology, PK, and toxicology data are present in Modules 4 and 2.6, but the integrated nonclinical overview (2.4) required by ICH M4 has not been prepared. This is a required section for NDA submissions.

sections.title: Clinical Overview
sections.notes: Clinical overview present but benefit-risk assessment section is incomplete. Hepatotoxicity signal identified in post-Phase 3 FAERS analysis is not discussed. Section 6 (Benefit-Risk) ends with '[DRAFT — UNDER MEDICAL REVIEW]'. The overview does not acknowledge the myalgia cluster identified in the signal analysis.

sections.title: Toxicology Written Summary
sections.notes: Toxicology written summary present. However, the reproductive toxicology section is sparse — only embryo-fetal development data for the rat are included; rabbit studies and pre/post-natal data are cited as 'ongoing'. The carcinogenicity sub-section references only the 6-month transgenic mouse study; the 2-year rat study results are listed as 'preliminary'.

sections.title: Summary of Biopharmaceutic Studies and Associated Analytical Methods
Summary of Clinical Safety
sections.notes: MISSING — The integrated summary of clinical safety has not been submitted. This is arguably the most critical safety section in Module 2 for pharmacovigilance purposes. Adverse event tables, serious adverse events, deaths, and discontinuation data must be presented here. Absence is a critical deficiency for any NDA.

sections.title: Synopses of Individual Studies
sections.notes: Synopses for SYN-101, SYN-201, SYN-301 included. SYN-401 (ongoing extension) synopsis marked as interim.

sections.title: Description and Composition of the Drug Product
Appendices
sections.notes: Adventitious agents safety evaluation included (biological excipient of animal origin used in manufacturing).

sections.title: Regional Information
sections.notes: FDA-specific: executed batch records and method validation packages.

sections.title: Pharmacology
sections.notes: Primary PD, secondary PD, and safety pharmacology studies completed. hERG channel assay included.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetics
sections.notes: Full ADME package in rat, dog, and human in vitro. CYP3A4 inhibition studies included.

sections.title: Single-Dose Toxicity
sections.notes: Rat and dog oral and IV single-dose studies. MTD established.

sections.title: Repeat-Dose Toxicity
sections.notes: 28-day and 90-day rat and dog repeat-dose studies completed. A 6-month rat study is present but the 9-month dog chronic study report is marked 'DRAFT — FINAL REPORT PENDING'. For a drug intended for chronic use, a complete 9-month dog package is expected. Hepatotoxicity findings at high dose (3× therapeutic) in the 90-day rat study are not discussed in Section 2.6.6.

sections.title: Genotoxicity
sections.notes: Ames test (negative), chromosomal aberration in vitro (negative), in vivo micronucleus (negative). Full standard battery complete.

sections.title: Carcinogenicity
sections.notes: Carcinogenicity section submitted (declared applicable — chronic-use drug). 6-month rasH2 transgenic mouse study complete. 2-year rat carcinogenicity study: only interim 12-month data submitted; final study report expected Q4 2024 per applicant's cover letter. Section is conditional-applicable and conditionally present, but final data required.

sections.title: Reproductive and Developmental Toxicity
sections.notes: MISSING — No completed reproductive toxicology study reports submitted. The rabbit embryo-fetal study (EFD) is listed as 'ongoing' in the applicant's cover letter. For a chronic-use drug in a population that may include women of childbearing potential, a complete reproductive package (fertility, EFD rat + rabbit, PPND) is required. This is a critical gap.

sections.title: Local Tolerance
sections.notes: Not applicable. Oral tablet formulation. No parenteral, topical, or other non-oral route of administration.

sections.title: Other Toxicity Studies
sections.notes: Immunotoxicity study included. Antigenicity assessment not applicable (small molecule). No dependence potential studies — applicant claims not applicable.

sections.title: Tabular Listing of All Clinical Studies
sections.notes: Lists 4 studies: SYN-101 (Phase 1, 48 subjects), SYN-201 (Phase 2, 240 subjects), SYN-301 (Phase 3, 1,820 subjects), SYN-401 (ongoing long-term extension, 540 subjects enrolled).

sections.title: Reports of Biopharmaceutic Studies
sections.notes: BA study, food-effect study, and comparative dissolution with reference product.

sections.title: Reports of Studies Pertinent to Pharmacokinetics Using Human Biomaterials
sections.notes: CYP3A4 inhibition/induction, plasma protein binding, hepatocyte metabolism studies.

sections.title: Reports of Human Pharmacokinetic Studies
sections.notes: Phase 1 SYN-101 report. PK in healthy volunteers, hepatic/renal impairment, drug interaction with CYP3A4 inhibitor.

sections.title: Reports of Human Pharmacodynamic Studies
sections.notes: LDL-C reduction PD studies from Phase 2 sub-study.

sections.title: Reports of Efficacy and Safety Studies
sections.notes: Phase 2 (SYN-201) and Phase 3 (SYN-301) study reports submitted. SYN-301 is the pivotal Phase 3 trial (1,820 patients, 52 weeks). However, the SYN-301 Clinical Study Report is marked 'FINAL v0.9 — PENDING QC SIGN-OFF'. Safety section of SYN-301 CSR lists 12 hepatic adverse events (ALT >3× ULN) that are not reconciled with the PRR signal detected in FAERS. SYN-401 long-term extension data not yet submitted.

sections.title: Reports of Post-Marketing Experience
sections.notes: Drug is approved in one non-ICH jurisdiction (fictional). Post-marketing safety report submitted but contains only 3 months of spontaneous report data (Jan–Mar 2024). Does not include PSUR or PBRER. Document references a 'full PSUR to follow' but no timeline is given. FAERS hepatotoxicity signal not discussed.

sections.title: Case Report Forms and Individual Patient Listings
sections.notes: CRFs and individual patient listings for all SAEs from SYN-101, SYN-201, SYN-301 included per ICH E3 requirements.

sections.title: Literature References
sections.notes: Published literature supporting the clinical data package. Includes key statin class-effect literature.
